sourceReviewNotes: All 24 paper pages and 35 scheme pages independently visually reviewed; 77 Higher and 55 Ordinary special-font/non-ASCII glyphs checked against source rendering. All 201 generated cards and 99 final figures reviewed.
All optional branches retained. Higher Q5(j) has two distinct-topic routes; each has its own seven-mark tariff. No exclusions.
Higher Q1 alternative acceleration methods are two complete four-step groups, each 12 marks. No mixing or adding alternative route totals.

Higher Q8 resistance/current calculation retains its shared nine-mark boundary. Higher Q12 cyclist calculation retains all three graph areas and every published component; music characteristics retain the shared property allocation.

Ordinary Q4 instrument and repeated-diameter tasks split at their six-mark boundaries. Ordinary Q6 separate collision energies, all apparatus and circuit diagrams, graph scales, source data and constants retained.

Historical marking guidance is clarified without rewriting the scheme: graph point counts, signed thermistor slope, oil insulation, friction, sound amplitude, rainbow dispersion and radiation matching.
Higher SAR passage and Ordinary Faraday passage retain complete context, illustrations and attribution in every derived task.

Opt-in glyph-baseline reading handles stacked indices, detached unit exponents, fraction layouts, reversed glyph order and segmented brackets without changing earlier generators. All 32 prior source checks passed unchanged and both new checks passed.

All 201 new IDs reached runtime without drops. All 3607 previous authored cards, 1830 Higher and 1766 Ordinary runtime blocks, 875 figure-manifest entries and 32 audit records preserved; unrelated subject files and coverage remain unchanged.
